title: Inter Women open Serie A at the Arena Civica today
description: Manuel Akanji and Petar Sucic both started for their countries on Saturday night, and Inter put the Double trophies on show at San Siro on Tuesday.
mast_alt: Nerazzurri Daily Edition No. 26, Sunday, September 27, 2026 — Inter Women open Serie A at the Arena Civica today

blocks.html: Inter Women open their Serie A season at home to Fiorentina at 7:00 AM ET today, 13:00 CEST. Entry at the Arena Civica is free. Manuel Akanji and Petar Sucic both started for their countries on Saturday night, and Inter put last season’s Double trophies on show at San Siro this week.

blocks.h3: Inter Women open Serie A at the Arena Civica today
paras: Inter Women play Fiorentina at 7:00 AM ET, which is 13:00 CEST, at the Arena Civica Gianni Brera in Milan. It is matchday 1 of Serie A Women, and entry is free. The club published its guide to the day on Saturday, with a DJ and a stadium announcer.

David Sassarini, the Inter Women head coach, comes into it off a 1–0 win over BK Häcken on their Champions League debut in Monza. Haley Bugeja, the Inter Women forward, scored in the fifth minute. Fiorentina are coached by Pablo Piñones Arce.

blocks.h3: Akanji and Sucic both start on Saturday night
paras: Manuel Akanji, the Inter center back, played all 90 minutes as Switzerland won 3–0 in North Macedonia. Petar Sucic, the Inter midfielder, played 88 minutes in Croatia’s 2–1 win in Prague, where the Croatia midfielders Luka Modric and Mario Pasalic scored in the second half.
Josep Martínez, the Inter goalkeeper, stayed on the bench as Spain won 3–2 at Wembley. Italy, with Nicolò Barella and Alessandro Bastoni, play Turkey in Bursa on Monday.

blocks.h3: The Double trophies go on show at San Siro this week
paras: Inter will put the Serie A and Coppa Italia trophies they won last season on display at the Inter Store inside San Siro. The doors are open on Tuesday, September 29 and Wednesday, September 30, from 4:00 AM ET to 1:30 PM ET, which is 10:00 to 19:30 CEST.
There is no charge, though the club asks visitors to be signed up to its INTERISTA membership program and to show the member avatar at the door.

blocks.h3: Gazzetta dello Sport: seven matches in 23 days for Chivu
paras: Gazzetta dello Sport, Italy’s biggest sports daily, counts seven matches in 23 days for Inter once Serie A returns. Four of the first five are at San Siro, and the run ends at the derby against Milan on October 31.
The paper expects Cristian Chivu, the Inter head coach, to rotate his way through it, and it notes that Milan have the lighter month of the two.
blocks.kicker: GAZZETTA DELLO SPORT VIA FCINTERNEWS · SEP 27

blocks.h3: Gazzetta dello Sport: Lautaro back only on the eve of Parma
paras: Lautaro Martínez, the Inter captain and forward, is expected in Buenos Aires on October 6 for Argentina’s farewell match for Lionel Messi, the Argentina captain.
Gazzetta puts him back at Appiano Gentile, Inter’s training ground, on Thursday, October 8 at the earliest. That would leave Chivu his captain only on the eve of the Parma match.
